a: Async context managers can handle startup and shutdown.
Custom response classes control serialization and headers.
jsonable_encoder converts common objects for JSON responses.
Form() declares form fields for application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
Cookie() reads values from request cookies.
Body(embed=True) nests a single parameter under its name.
Path convertors constrain path parameter types.
Swagger UI can use OAuth2 for authorized try-it-out.
Include /v1 in routes for explicit API versions.
Close DB pools and clients during shutdown handlers.
